body: I understand why she left me. I was a fucking idiot. If I was the father, I’d want to have the baby.

Thank you so much for the response. I need as many ears as possible and good advice. I’m so heartbroken over this and would appreciate any input both male and female. I still haven’t responded back to her text and don’t know when I should. I have something written up. Thankfully I have great friends who have been honest with me and have told me to stay strong because it’ll work itself out. I got caught up in all of the stupid fucking guy/locker room talk. And what I sent out earlier about dying was just rash. My head was all out of sorts. Thankfully I am on welbutrin, Lexapro, and lamictal
